    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "Transactions between the central bank and the public merely substitute bond assets for cash without changing reserves.",

      "premise_quote": "Selling of a bond by RBI (to private individuals or institutions) leads to reduction in quantity of reserves and hence the money supply.",
